<thought>From the measured resistances, each internal node (N_b1, N_b2, N_b3) provides a series path between the terminals B and X1. The values are:

- B‑N_b1 = 45 Ω, N_b1‑X1 = 5 Ω  
- B‑N_b2 = 35 Ω, N_b2‑X1 = 15 Ω  
- B‑N_b3 = 20 Ω, N_b3‑X1 = 30 Ω  

All three paths give the same total B‑X1 resistance (50 Ω), matching the direct measurement. This matches all other pairwise measurements when the three branches are considered in parallel. Therefore the subnetwork consists of six resistors arranged as three parallel branches, each branch containing two series resistors. The required JSON description lists these six resistors and their connections.</thought>
